title: Microbial diversity in A/O MBBR using methanol and food waste condensate
description: This study investigates the microbial community structures in both suspended sludge and biofilm attached to carriers in an anaerobic/oxic moving bed biofilm reactor (A/O MBBR) treating synthetic wastewater. Two external carbon sources, methanol and food waste condensate (FWC), were applied to assess their influence on microbial diversity. High-throughput 16S rRNA gene sequencing was conducted to compare the bacterial communities in different carbon source conditions and biomass types, and to evaluate the resulting denitrification performance.
